name: Ducati 900SS / MHR (bevel)
engine: 864 or 973 cc air-cooled bevel-drive desmo V-twin, two carbs
intro: The square-case bevel 900s. Desmo heads, big carbs and the race replica bodywork on the MHR.

H: The bevel-drive cams are set with shims and need patience. Check the bevel gear backlash and the desmo shims before you run it hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
